\begin{lexlean}{CandidateSourceTraces}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\importmodule{CandidateSource}
\importmodule{CandidateBinding}
\importmodule{ClosedGoalTraces}
\importmodule{CoreBinding}
\importmodule{Research}
\importmodule{Json}
\importmodule{Toml}
\title{Boolean}
\begin{semanticmodule}

definition{
 name: truth,
 parameters: [],
 result: CoreBinding::Goal,
 body: (record CoreBinding::Goal {nodes := (prim append (project (CoreBinding::namedGoal 0x54727565) nodes) (project (CoreBinding::namedGoal 0x547275652e696e74726f) nodes) : (List Json::Value)), root := 0}),
 axioms: []
}

definition{
 name: request,
 parameters: [origin : Bytes],
 result: Research::Request,
 body: (ClosedGoalTraces::request origin (ClosedGoalTraces::goalBytes origin) (ctor Research::GoalKind.closed) 0x 0 (ctor Research::Purpose.prove)),
 axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
 name: source,
 parameters: [origin : Bytes, proof : Nat, axioms : (List String)],
 result: (Option Bytes),
 body: (CandidateSource::construct (request origin) (truth) proof (cons 0x496e6974 (nil Bytes)) (nil Bytes) axioms 4096 32 1024),
 axioms: [propext]
}

theorem{
 name: constructClosedTruth,
 parameters: [],
 statement: ((match (source 0x54727565 1 (nil String)) | Option.none => false | Option.some data => true) = true),
 proof: decide{},
 axioms: [propext]
}

theorem{
 name: cannotSubstituteTruthForTheRequestedPrizeGoal,

 statement: ((source 0x52756c696f6c6f67792e43656c6c756c61724175746f6d6174612e52756c6533305072697a652e50726f626c656d31 1 (nil String)) = (ctor Option.none [Bytes])),
 proof: decide{},
 axioms: [propext]
}

theorem{
 name: missingProofNodeCannotBeEmitted,

}

theorem{
 name: forbiddenAxiomCannotBeEmitted,
 parameters: [],

}

theorem{
 name: sourceWrapperCountsAgainstTheByteBudget,
 parameters: [],
 statement: ((CandidateSource::encode (truth) 1 (cons 0x496e6974 (nil Bytes)) (nil Bytes) (nil String) 100 1024) = (ctor Option.none [Bytes])),
 proof: decide{},
 axioms: [propext]
}

theorem{
 name: inspectionCannotBecomeAProofCandidate,
 parameters: [],
 statement: ((CandidateSource::construct (ClosedGoalTraces::request 0x54727565 (ClosedGoalTraces::goalBytes 0x54727565) (ctor Research::GoalKind.closed) 0x 0 (ctor Research::Purpose.inspect)) (truth) 1 (cons 0x496e6974 (nil Bytes)) (nil Bytes) (nil String) 4096 32 1024) = (ctor Option.none [Bytes])),
 proof: decide{},
 axioms: [propext]
}

theorem{
 name: axiomOrderAndDuplicatesDoNotChangeTheCandidate,
 parameters: [],
 statement: ((match (source 0x54727565 1 (cons "propext" (cons "Quot.sound" (cons "propext" (nil String))))) | Option.none => false | Option.some left => (match (source 0x54727565 1 (cons "Quot.sound" (cons "propext" (nil String)))) | Option.none => false | Option.some right => (Toml::sameBytes left right))) = true),
 proof: decide{},
 axioms: [propext]
}

theorem{
 name: nativeNotationMatchesCompilerAcceptedSource,
 parameters: [],
 statement: ((match (source 0x54727565 1 (nil String)) | Option.none => false | Option.some text => (Toml::sameBytes text )) = true),
 proof: decide{},
 axioms: [propext]
}


definition{

}

definition{
 name: identityProof,
 parameters: [],

}

theorem{

 proof: decide{},

}

theorem{
 name: synthesisEmitsTheSameTruthCandidateAsExplicitConstruction,
 parameters: [],
 statement: ((match (CandidateSource::synthesize (request 0x54727565) 4096 32 1024) | Option.none => false | Option.some proposal => (match (CandidateSource::construct (request 0x54727565) (first proposal) (second proposal) (cons 0x496e6974 (nil Bytes)) (nil Bytes) (nil String) 4096 32 1024) | Option.none => false | Option.some generated => (match (source 0x54727565 1 (nil String)) | Option.none => false | Option.some explicit => (Toml::sameBytes generated explicit)))) = true),

}
